description: This Java class defines a JobService for monitoring changes in photos stored on an Android device. It sets up a scheduled job that triggers when media content related to images changes, and performs a simple task of querying and displaying information about new or modified photos within a specified directory.

classes.name: PhotosContentJob
classes.description: A JobService implementation that monitors media provider for changes in photos, processes change events, and displays summaries to the user.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the job if it is not already scheduled, using JobScheduler.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Checks whether the job is currently scheduled.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled job if it is currently active.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Handles the job start event; processes triggered content URIs to determine updated photos and displays this information.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Handles the job stop event, cleaning up as needed.
